localizedValues.name: Oversized - 8:00 am - 12:00 pm
localizedValues.description: 4-hour time slots. This is for an oversized parking space: Exclusive to single vehicles measuring between 6 and 13 metres (20 to 42.5 feet) in length (motor homes, vehicles towing trailers etc.). Maximum of 12 passengers and not for commercial vehicles. Vehicles not meeting this description will be denied parking access. Please contact the park before making your reservation if you have any questions.

localizedValues.name: Surdimensionné - 8 h 00 - 12 h 00
localizedValues.description: Créneaux de quatre (4) heures.
